CHARACTER & WARDROBE · OCTOBER 7

Wardrobe, taking shape.

Four character directions. Four 3D drafts.

See the retained artwork and open its original files. The character pictures are illustrations; the separate 3D drafts are starting shapes for further authorship. They have not been assembled or fitted as complete outfits.

Character directions

Whole-character illustrations for discussing shape, materials and face framing.

ILLUSTRATED CHARACTER DIRECTION

Soft knit, wider legs

A relaxed blue knit, charcoal trousers and brown boots, with an open face and calm material palette.

A discussion target. Editable character, hidden surfaces and wearable fit remain to be authored.

Open complete original image ↗
Design brief

ILLUSTRATED CHARACTER DIRECTION

Short groom, open layers

A swept short groom and olive overshirt over an ivory tee, with sandstone trousers and brown lace-up boots.

A discussion target. A supported starter character, complete layering and moving appearance remain open.

Open complete original image ↗
Design brief

ILLUSTRATED CHARACTER DIRECTION

Silver bob, long layers

Mara's silver bob and warm layers: an open cardigan, visible skirt waist and a plum midi hem above low leather loafers.

An artist discussion target. Editable character, garment fit, motion and runtime use remain open.

Open complete original image ↗
Design brief

ILLUSTRATED CHARACTER DIRECTION

Short rust layers, broader volume

Ari's short jacket and generous trousers, with distinct front, profile and rear views to discuss torso depth, seat and garment balance.

Artist discussion artwork. Material and waist details need further authorship; editable character, wearable fit and motion remain open.

EDITABLE ARTIST DRAFT · UNITLESS

Sweater volume

A continuous torso and sleeves in a simple T-rest scaffold. Shoulder room, relaxed fall and knit finish are still to be shaped.

Body fit, physical dimensions and movement are unqualified.

EDITABLE ARTIST DRAFT · UNITLESS

Wide trousers

A shared crotch, fuller seat and broad straight legs. The front, profile and rear reveal the starting silhouette.

Fabric folds, the trouser-to-boot break, body fit and movement remain open.

EDITABLE ARTIST DRAFT · UNITLESS

Open overshirt

An open front, attached collar, full sleeves and back volume. Small collar leaves and angular shoulders remain coarse.

Cuff finish, cloth, layering, body fit and movement remain open.

EDITABLE ARTIST DRAFT · UNITLESS

Paired ankle boots

Rounded forefeet, crossing laces, ankle rims and rear counters. Faceted insteps and raised details remain a coarse blockout.

The interior reference is fictional. Anatomical fit, leather finish and movement remain open.

From these drafts to a wearable character

Finished surfaces, coherent proportions, body and foundation coverage, layering, expression and movement still need work. The complete character goal stays open.
